## Author checklist

- [ ] CI is green (lint, GoogleTest, pytest, Docker build)
- [ ] New logic is covered by unit tests, including edge cases and invalid input
- [ ] No look-ahead bias / off-by-one in any time-series code
- [ ] Public functions have a short comment explaining inputs, units and errors
- [ ] `k8s/` and `docker-compose.yml` updated if ports, env vars or images changed
- [ ] PR is small enough to review in ~15 minutes (split it otherwise)
